name: hero-fade-v1
about: T-170 #101 / T-183 scene a (the user's first catch, C-058): the hero cards fading out, and before it scene c (crop): the hero countdown at rest. Load, 1.5 s, mark rest, 12 s at rest at the top (cards in orbit, countdown ticking; hold.sh starts this driver at Mac second :40 of a minute, so the countdown crop's 6 s window starts at the same whole second of the page's clock on both arms and shows the same seconds on both sides; the frozen page counts down to 2026-11-02 05:00Z), then mark fade and three slow drags of 400 px in 2400 ms each (finger on the glass, no momentum, plateau ~178 px/s) with 300 ms between them: the page goes through the hero track (the cards scatter and fade over its first ~850 px), then 1.5 s at rest. Speed fixed here before any capture; same input on both arms.
